metadata.title: EU Law Territorial Application & EUDR Regulated Scope

properties.name: Indonesia
properties.jurisdiction_label: EUDR Regulated Sourcing Area (Third-Country Origin)
properties.market_status: Regulated Supply Chain Origin for EU Market Entry
properties.regulatory_mandate: Mandatory statutory due diligence: commodities entering the EU single market must prove zero deforestation after 31 December 2020 cutoff.
properties.operator_obligation: EU importers and domestic suppliers must obtain polygon geolocation, verify zero canopy loss via bi-temporal satellite audit, and register Due Diligence Statements.

properties.name: Cyprus
properties.jurisdiction_label: EU Member State (Direct Statutory EU Law)
properties.regulatory_mandate: Full direct statutory application. Competent Authorities execute due diligence verification (Art. 14-19), customs interception, and TRACES NT reference clearance.
properties.operator_obligation: Domestic EU forestry & agricultural operators must submit Due Diligence Statements (DDS) to EU TRACES NT before placing relevant commodities on single market or exporting.
